Title: Logo returns the user to the home page from another page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Help.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The Help page loads with the h1 Help and the logo with alt text Proficiency Testing homepage is visible in the navigation bar.

Step Action: Confirm the browser address ends with /Help.aspx.
Step Expected: The address path is /Help.aspx, so the user is not on the home page.

Step Action: Click the logo in the navigation bar.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the home page and the address path is /Home.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Stop on the home page without selecting anything else.
Step Expected: The user remains on /Home.aspx and no error page is shown.

Title: Footer links open the expected internal page for each link
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user and scroll to the footer.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer shows the links Help, Accessibility Statement, System Information and Privacy Policy.

Step Action: Click the Help link in the footer.
Step Expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /Help.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the Help page.
Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
Step Expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

Step Action: Click the Accessibility Statement link in the footer.
Step Expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /AccessibilityStatement.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the Accessibility Statement page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website.

Step Action: Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
Step Expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

Step Action: Click the System Information link in the footer.
Step Expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /About.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the System Information page.
Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
Step Expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

Step Action: Click the Privacy Policy link in the footer.
Step Expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /PrivacyPolicy.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the Privacy Policy page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Privacy Notice.
